_doc: Weekly Acceleration Watch, named startups showing the strongest GitHub engineering acceleration the week of `weekStart`. Each cohort is graded post-hoc against public fundraise / acquisition / shutdown news at the 60-day and 90-day windows. Methodology: ssrn.com/abstract=6606558.
_legal: This is a data-driven engineering activity watchlist generated from public GitHub data. It is not investment advice. Naming a company indicates that its observed engineering activity matches the patterns described in our methodology, it does not assert that the company is fundraising, will fundraise, or has any specific intent. Outcomes are recorded post-hoc from public announcements only.

_grading._doc: Outcome enum. `null` = not yet graded. Pending picks remain null until the 60d window closes.

values.raised: Public funding round announced (any stage) within the grading window.
values.acquired: Acquisition or merger announced within the grading window.
values.ipo: Public listing or direct listing announced within the grading window.
values.other_milestone: Other observable public milestone (major hire announced, product launch, named customer, partnership) but no funding event.
values.no_event: No publicly observable milestone within the grading window.
values.shutdown: Company shut down or paused operations.
values.excluded: Pick withdrawn from grading (data error, duplicate, or non-venture entity).

picks.name: zapplyjobs
picks.thesis: Pre-seed US jobs platform sustaining 1,694 commits over 14 days with the contributor signal pointing to a hiring burst. The combination of pre-seed stage and high commit volume is the textbook pre-seed-to-seed acceleration profile.
picks.outcomeNotes: Graded 2026-07-31 (60-day window closed 2026-07-03): no public funding, acquisition, IPO, or shutdown announcement found for this organization via news search.
